title: R2 native diagnostic actual-source analysis
purpose: Independent Git-copy-only diagnostic; neither business fix nor final budget acceptance

run.sourceOfRunIdentity: Root task assignment; input revision independently cross-checked

windowAudit.scope: all actual pg.Client.query calls and PostgreSQL protocol bytes in the primary API process; no sampling
windowAudit.background: all concurrent primary API background traffic is included; no guessed subtraction or per-request attribution
windowAudit.boundary: query calls started and protocol bytes transferred by each checkpoint; in-flight response bytes can cross a checkpoint
exclusions: test-account lease/session tracking and fixture SQL in the separate harness process
PostgreSQL connection handshake and TCP/TLS overhead
windowAudit.diagnosticBoundary: SQL calls belong to (before.queryCalls, after.queryCalls]; completion times never choose a SQL window. IDs show ALS origin, including inherited background work; a captured null action is never backfilled. Structure equality proves neither equal parameters nor redundant work.

sequenceTail.scopeOfMissingTimes: unknown; some can fall before original end; no outside-window assertion

integrity.rawCounterInterpretation: drop/other/failure counters report collector observations; they are not deduplicated producer events. One producer UUID per observed document does not imply global module uniqueness.

facts: Web has two observed documents and Native three, each with exactly one observed producer UUID.
Both clients have four SQL invocations for each of bots, teams, projectTeams, summaries, threads, chat and issues. This is actual action inventory, not proof of identical arguments across calls.
Native's final document has socket_open after25 on channel39 and after27 on channel41; ready assigns coverage26/28 and is not itself a key invalidation.
Native final socket-open invalidation records cover10 unique keys with10 flushes; late-subscribe records cover4 unique keys with4 flushes.
The final Native taskRuns/chat/threads keys refresh at coverage26 and summaries at coverage28 after late-subscribe; bots/issues are socket25 and teams/projectTeams are socket27.
Web document1 uses socket17; Web document2 uses socket19 and21; Native middle document uses socket25.
Observed initial read entries have no preceding same-key fresh chain in their document; mount/focus remains unknown.
The repeated same-key read_fresh branches are not counted as extra physical or logical RPC. Each relevant key has one initial and one later observed read_entry per instrumented usable document.

Web product dispatches in the unchanged window total35. Native product dispatches in the unchanged window total39 after singleton presentation correction; original server totals40 include one desktop.session with no product event. An extra Native bootstrap is before the window and is retained separately.

Among full-window query-bearing named SQL invocations, Web has35 unique action/time candidates; Native has33 unique,1 ambiguous and5 unjoined because product terminal bounds are missing. No candidate is labeled an exact cross-layer identity.

parserCaveats.description: Frozen original parser lists the singleton outer dispatch and item child as two logical rows. The raw output remains unchanged. Corrected presentation selects item-bearing children whenever present, otherwise the outer action. Server logical counts are unaffected.
Occurrences are query-bearing contexts only; queryless desktop.session does not appear in this index. Original lifecycle physical/logical inventories are kept separately.

The original bounded-terminal-only algorithm intentionally leaves5 final Native named SQL invocations unjoined when decoded/failed is missing. A retained dispatch alone is not silently promoted to a complete join.

limitations: No shared ID joins product requests, CDP requests and server SQL invocations.
SQL invocation indices and occurrence numbers cover query-bearing invocations only; original physical/logical RPC totals remain separate.
Product object IDs require page/document/producer namespace; ID zero is omission. CDP IDs have a separate page-local namespace.
React mount and SWR focus are not directly instrumented; no observed Live chain means unknown, never proof of mount/focus.
A key/action/shape match does not prove identical arguments, owner, workspace or redundant work.
Original query membership is ordinal-based, never changed by this timestamp index; setup and tail events remain present.
Sidecar gaps, omissions, drops and late attachment prevent negative causal conclusions.
Wall and document/CDP clocks are retained separately, without tolerance, clock correction or inferred document navigation IDs.
Live associations expose observed source-order/key/after candidates; overlapping/coalesced triggers retain ambiguity.
This diagnostic has CPU/IPC cost and cannot establish the formal final SQL budget PASS.
Absence of not_returned/covers/etc in retained Native data is not a universal absence claim.
Raw keys, user/workspace identifiers, URL queries and request bodies are not available; no argument-equivalence or redundancy claim.
Late attachment, missing records and schemaOther values remain explicit incomplete evidence.
Installed daemon differs between d2c and R2. No new diagnostic rerun is requested.
Original FIRST pair1 and all four SQL windows, ordinals, unknowns and background are retained.
